title: Griffiths & Lane example 2, slope with a foundation layer

meta.title: Griffiths & Lane example 2, slope with a foundation layer
meta.notes: The 2:1 slope (c/γH = 0.05, φ = 20°) on a foundation of the same soil; unconstrained circular search finds the toe circle. Converted to SI.

source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V055 (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Bishop & Morgenstern (1960) charts, as Griffiths & Lane quote them: 1.380 for the slope without the foundation layer (their example 1, D = 1) and 1.752 with it (D = 1.5), which belongs to a circle tangent to the base of the layer; in cSlope a circle forced tangent to that base gives 1.70. The critical circle is a toe circle, as in Griffiths & Lane's finite-element mechanism, and the factor is essentially that of example 1.
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
